case_title: NORTHERN CALIFORNIA BAKERY DRIVERS SECURITY FUND VS DEAN JOHN IND/DBA AHRENS BAKERY et al

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $672.00 FILED BY NORTHERN CALIFORNIA BAKERY DRIVERS SECURITY FUND AS TO DEFENDANT DEAN JOHN IND/DBA AHRENS BAKERY DEAN SUSAN IND/DBA AHRENS BAKERY ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR SEP-08-1995 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT C
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT DEAN JOHN IND/DBA AHRENS BAKERY
SUBSTITUTED PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT DEAN SUSAN IND/DBA AHRENS BAKERY

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF NORTHERN CALIFORNIA BAKERY DRIVERS SECURITY FUND IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT DEAN JOHN IND/DBA AHRENS BAKERY DEAN SUSAN IND/DBA AHRENS BAKERY STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
